title: Michael Kratsios statement on manipulating time and space
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Michael Kratsios statement on manipulating time and space, about 2025 at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, you heard the Michael Kratsios statement. We are capable of so much more. Our technologies permit us to manipulate time and space. They leave distance annihilated.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to a 2025 statement by Michael Kratsios, a US government official. Michels quotes him as saying that we are capable of so much more, that our technologies let us manipulate time and space, and that they leave distance annihilated. Michels takes it as a hint that the government may be sitting on far more advanced technology than the public knows about.
